- 工业源 fossil fuel fixed combustion (INDUSTRIAL_BOILER): enterprise industry ∈ B06-B12, C13-C43, D45 (采矿业、制造业、燃气生产和供应业) AND the device is an 工业锅炉 (industrial boiler). Also per 8.3: 化石燃料固定燃烧包括...燃烧化石燃料的工业锅炉.
- Everything else: OUT_OF_SCOPE (范围外).

Now what about the device type within the B102 row: 电站锅炉/燃气轮机 vs 工业锅炉. For a power enterprise (4411 etc.), the devices are power boilers/gas turbines (电站锅炉/燃气轮机) — e.g. 燃煤发电锅炉, 燃气轮机, 垃圾焚烧炉 (biomass/waste). For heat supply (4430), devices could be industrial-boiler-like but they belong to 电力热力源 per the standard (热力生产和供应 is in 电力热力源 scope).

Hmm wait, but should a 4430 enterprise's boiler be classified as POWER (电力热力源) even if it's recorded in the 工业锅炉 fields of B102? The standard 7.1 says 电力热力源包括...及热力生产和供应（D4430）的企业生产设施产生的大气污染物排放 — yes, all production facilities of D4430 enterprises are 电力热力源. So decision by enterprise industry code is primary. The B102 row device type (电站锅炉 vs 工业锅炉) is secondary info.

Hmm, but there's a subtlety: what if a 制造业 enterprise has a 电站锅炉 (e.g., self-owned power plant)? Per the standard, 电力热力源 is defined by industry (4411/4412/4417/4430). A manufacturing enterprise's boilers are industrial boilers (工业锅炉). The B102 "工业锅炉" fields would be filled for manufacturing enterprises. If a manufacturing enterprise somehow has 电站锅炉 fields filled... that'd be unusual; per the standard they'd still be industrial source (工业锅炉 classification), hmm, or actually per the strict standard, only 采矿业/制造业/燃气供应业 (B/C/D45) devices are 工业源 fossil fixed combustion, and everything else is out of scope. A 电站锅炉 in a manufacturing enterprise — the standard doesn't have a category for that; closest is 8.3 industrial boiler. Hmm. But let me first look at the actual data to see what patterns exist. Let me not over-theorize before looking at the data.

Also I need to check: 污染物历史产生量和排放量已统一留空 (generation/emission columns blanked). And "只能根据未留空的源字段和 PDF 自主建立处理逻辑" — only use non-blank source fields and the PDF.

The B102 row fields (per device):
- 电站锅炉/燃气轮机编号, 类型代码, 类型 (R4 燃生物质锅炉 etc.), 对应机组编号, 装机容量（万千瓦）, 燃烧方式代码, 燃烧方式, 额定出力（蒸吨/小时）, 运行时间（小时）, 低氮燃烧
- 工业锅炉编号, 类型代码, 类型 (R3 燃气锅炉 etc.), 用途代码, 用途, 燃烧方式代码, 燃烧方式, 额定出力, 运行时间, 低氮燃烧
- 发电量（万千瓦时）, 供热量（万吉焦）
- 燃料一: 类型代码, 类型, 消耗量, 单位, 发电消耗量, 供热消耗量, 低位发热量, 含硫量+单位, 灰分, 挥发分, 碳含量, 碳氧化率
- 燃料二: same
- 其他燃料消耗总量（吨标准煤）
- 排放口编号, coords, 高度
- 工业废气排放量（万立方米） — blank (answer isolation)
- pollutant gen/emission columns — blank

So the activity data: fuel consumption (燃料一/燃料二 消耗量 with units). Emission factors: from 表D.1 (power) / 表E.7 (industrial boilers), with coal material balance via 附录C, gas fuel factors in g/m³.

Units matter: 表D.1/E.7 factors are g/kg fuel; for gas fuels (天然气, 焦炉煤气, 高炉煤气, 转炉煤气, 其它煤气, 其它气体燃料) units are g/m³ (per note c). The consumption of 天然气 is in 万立方米. 焦炉煤气 etc. might be in 万立方米 too.

What about fuel types like 城市生活垃圾 (municipal solid waste, used as fuel), 生物质? The tables D.1/E.7 don't include biomass/waste. Hmm. For 生物质能发电 (D4417), the standard presumably has factors... but table D.1 doesn't show biomass rows. Let me check the rest of D.1 — I saw up to 其它石油制品 for 热力生产和供应. The D.1 table seems to cover only 煤炭/焦炭/煤矸石/焦化产品/煤气/天然气/LNG/LPG/炼厂干气/原油/汽油/煤油/柴油/燃料油/其它液体燃料/石油焦/石油沥青/其它石油制品. No biomass, no MSW. Hmm.

Wait — for biomass/waste, the standard references 生态环境部公告 2014年 第92号 附件5 (生物质燃烧源大气污染物排放清单编制技术指南（试行）)? That's for open biomass burning. Hmm. For power plants burning MSW/biomass... The D.1 table doesn't have them. So for such fuels (城市生活垃圾, 生物质), the generation coefficients can't be obtained from the PDF → 信息不足 (information_insufficient) for those pollutants? Or the whole device?

Hold on. Let me look at what fuel types appear in the actual B102 data before deciding. The candidate set is 1481 devices (25% scale). Let me analyze the data: industry codes distribution, device types, fuel types, whether both fuel1 and fuel2 present, blank patterns, etc.

Also the 基101-2001 (enterprise master) provides enterprise-level fuel consumption (煤炭消费量, 燃料煤消费量, 燃料油, 焦炭, 天然气, 其他燃料, 锅炉数, 蒸吨数 etc.) and industry codes. The B102 (device) has per-device fuel consumption. For the inventory, per-device data is preferred (point source per device).

The control facility base 基101-2002 has per-enterprise control facilities: 编号, 名称, 排放口代码, 排放口名称, 处理能力, 运行费用, 处理工艺名称, 去除效率. The B102 devices have 排放口编号 (e.g., DA001). The control facility rows have 对应的排放口代码 (e.g., QT) — hmm, 'QT' = 其他排放口. So we can link control facilities to devices via 排放口. The 处理工艺名称 (process name, e.g., 袋式除尘法) and 去除效率 (%) allow determining control efficiencies.

OK. Now let me systematically analyze the data. First, load B102 fully and summarize: industry codes, device type fields, fuel types, units, missingness. Also load 基101-2001 to get enterprise master info (industry codes, names) and 基101-2002 control facilities.

{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Analyze B102 candidate devices: industry, device type, fuels, blanks."""
import pandas as pd, collections, json, os

OUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "outputs")
b102 = pd.read_pickle(os.path.join(OUT, "_b102.pkl"))

print("=== 行业类别代码 distribution (top 40) ===")
vc = b102["行业类别代码"].value_counts()
for code, n in vc.items():
    name = b102.loc[b102["行业类别代码"] == code, "行业类别名称"].iloc[0]
    print(f"  {code} {name}: {n}")

print("\n=== device type fields: 电站锅炉/燃气轮机编号 vs 工业锅炉编号 ===")
ps = b102["电站锅炉/燃气轮机编号"].notna() & (b102["电站锅炉/燃气轮机编号"].astype(str).str.strip() != "")
ib = b102["工业锅炉编号"].notna() & (b102["工业锅炉编号"].astype(str).str.strip() != "")
print("电站锅炉 filled:", ps.sum(), "| 工业锅炉 filled:", ib.sum(), "| both:", (ps & ib).sum(), "| neither:", (~ps & ~ib).sum())

print("\n=== 电站锅炉/燃气轮机类型 ===")
print(b102.loc[ps, "电站锅炉/燃气轮机类型"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())
print("\n=== 工业锅炉类型 ===")
print(b102.loc[ib, "工业锅炉类型"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())
print("\n=== 工业锅炉用途 ===")
print(b102.loc[ib, "工业锅炉用途"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())
print("\n=== 电站锅炉燃烧方式 ===")
print(b102.loc[ps, "电站锅炉燃烧方式"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())
print("\n=== 工业锅炉燃烧方式 ===")
print(b102.loc[ib, "工业锅炉燃烧方式"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())

print("\n=== 燃料一类型 ===")
print(b102["燃料一类型"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())
print("\n=== 燃料二类型 ===")
print(b102["燃料二类型"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())

print("\n=== 燃料一消耗量单位 ===")
print(b102["燃料一消耗量单位"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())
print("\n=== 燃料二消耗量单位 ===")
print(b102["燃料二消耗量单位"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())

print("\n=== 其他燃料消耗总量（吨标准煤） filled:", (b102["其他燃料消耗总量（吨标准煤）"].notna() & (b102["其他燃料消耗总量（吨标准煤）"] != 0)).sum())

print("\n=== 发电量/供热量 filled (nonzero) ===")
print("发电量:", (b102["发电量（万千瓦时）"].fillna(0) != 0).sum(), "供热量:", (b102["供热量（万吉焦）"].fillna(0) != 0).sum())

# blank analysis for fuel consumption
f1 = pd.to_numeric(b102["燃料一消耗量"], errors="coerce")
f2 = pd.to_numeric(b102["燃料二消耗量"], errors="coerce")
print("\n燃料一消耗量 numeric non-null:", f1.notna().sum(), "| zero:", (f1.fillna(0) == 0).sum())
print("燃料二消耗量 numeric non-null:", f2.notna().sum(), "| zero:", (f2.fillna(0) == 0).sum())

# pollution columns blank check
poll_cols = ["二氧化硫产生量（吨）", "二氧化硫排放量（吨）", "氮氧化物产生量（吨）", "氮氧化物排放量（吨）",
             "颗粒物产生量（吨）", "颗粒物排放量（吨）", "挥发性有机物产生量（千克）", "挥发性有机物排放量（千克）"]
for c in poll_cols:
    nonnull = b102[c].notna().sum()
    print(f"  {c}: non-null {nonnull}")

{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Cross-tab device rows by industry, device type, fuel for POWER-relevant industries."""
import pandas as pd, os

OUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "outputs")
b102 = pd.read_pickle(os.path.join(OUT, "_b102.pkl"))

POWER_IND = {"4411": "火力发电", "4412": "热电联产", "4417": "生物质能发电", "4430": "热力生产和供应"}
ind = b102["行业类别代码"].astype(str)
b102["_ind"] = ind

def devtype(r):
    ps = str(r["电站锅炉/燃气轮机编号"]).strip() not in ("", "nan")
    return "电站锅炉" if ps else "工业锅炉"
b102["_devtype"] = b102.apply(devtype, axis=1)

print("=== 电站锅炉 rows by industry ===")
print(b102[b102["_devtype"] == "电站锅炉"]["行业类别代码"].value_counts().to_string())

print("\n=== POWER industries devices: fuel1 x devtype ===")
mask = b102["_ind"].isin(POWER_IND.keys())
sub = b102[mask]
print("POWER devices total:", len(sub))
print(sub.groupby(["_ind", "_devtype"])["燃料一类型"].value_counts().to_string())

print("\n=== POWER devices fuel1 units ===")
print(sub.groupby("燃料一类型")["燃料一消耗量单位"].value_counts().to_string())

print("\n=== POWER devices 电站锅炉燃烧方式 (where filled) ===")
print(sub.loc[sub["_devtype"] == "电站锅炉", "电站锅炉燃烧方式"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())
print("\n=== POWER devices 工业锅炉燃烧方式 (where filled) ===")
print(sub.loc[sub["_devtype"] == "工业锅炉", "工业锅炉燃烧方式"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())

print("\n=== POWER devices 装机容量 (万千瓦) distribution ===")
cap = pd.to_numeric(sub["对应机组装机容量（万千瓦）"], errors="coerce")
print(cap.describe().to_string())
print("non-null:", cap.notna().sum(), "of", len(sub))

print("\n=== 低氮燃烧 (电站) ===")
print(sub["是否采用低氮燃烧技术"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())
print("=== 低氮燃烧 (工业) ===")
print(sub["是否采用低氮燃烧技术.1"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())

print("\n=== 其他燃料消耗总量 in POWER devices ===")
print(sub.loc[sub["其他燃料消耗总量（吨标准煤）"].notna() & (sub["其他燃料消耗总量（吨标准煤）"] != 0), ["_ind", "其他燃料消耗总量（吨标准煤）"]].to_string())

# fuel2 within POWER
print("\n=== POWER devices fuel2 ===")
sub2 = sub[sub["燃料二类型"].notna() & (sub["燃料二类型"].astype(str).str.strip() != "")]
print(sub2[["_ind", "_devtype", "燃料一类型", "燃料一消耗量", "燃料一消耗量单位", "燃料二类型", "燃料二消耗量", "燃料二消耗量单位"]].to_string())

{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify classification of all candidates; check edge cases in POWER subset."""
import pandas as pd, os, json

BASE = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "inputs")
OUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "outputs")
b102 = pd.read_pickle(os.path.join(OUT, "_b102.pkl"))

ind = b102["行业类别代码"].astype(str)
def classify(icode):
    if icode in ("4411", "4412", "4417", "4430"):
        return "POWER"
    # B06-12, C13-43, D45 per T/CSES 8.1 (采矿/制造/燃气生产和供应业)
    if icode[:2] in [f"{i:02d}" for i in range(6, 13)] or (13 <= int(icode[:2]) <= 43) or icode[:2] == "45":
        return "INDUSTRIAL_BOILER"
    return "OUT_OF_SCOPE"

b102["_cls"] = ind.apply(classify)
print(b102["_cls"].value_counts().to_string())
print("\nOUT_OF_SCOPE industries:")
oos = b102[b102["_cls"] == "OUT_OF_SCOPE"]
print(oos.groupby(["行业类别代码", "行业类别名称"]).size().to_string())
print("\nINDUSTRIAL_BOILER industries (all):")
print(sorted(b102[b102["_cls"] == "INDUSTRIAL_BOILER"]["行业类别代码"].unique()))

print("\n=== POWER subset edge checks ===")
pw = b102[b102["_cls"] == "POWER"].copy()
f1 = pd.to_numeric(pw["燃料一消耗量"], errors="coerce")
f2 = pd.to_numeric(pw["燃料二消耗量"], errors="coerce")
print("POWER f1 NaN:", f1.isna().sum(), "| f1==0:", (f1 == 0).sum())
print(pw.loc[f1.isna() | (f1 == 0), ["source_id" if "source_id" in pw.columns else "_excel_row"]].to_string() if "source_id" in pw.columns else "")

# coal devices: check S, ash, combustion, capacity
coal = pw[pw["燃料一类型"].isin(["一般烟煤", "原煤", "无烟煤", "褐煤"])]
print("\nPOWER coal devices:", len(coal))
print("coal fuel1 S blank:", coal["燃料一平均收到基含硫量"].isna().sum())
print("coal fuel1 ash blank:", coal["燃料一平均收到基灰分（%）"].isna().sum())
devtype = coal.apply(lambda r: "电站" if str(r["电站锅炉/燃气轮机编号"]).strip() not in ("", "nan") else "工业", axis=1)
coal["_dt"] = devtype
print("\ncoal by industry x devtype:")
print(coal.groupby(["行业类别代码", "_dt"]).size().to_string())
print("\ncoal combustion method (电站):")
print(coal.loc[coal["_dt"] == "电站", "电站锅炉燃烧方式"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())
print("coal combustion method (工业):")
print(coal.loc[coal["_dt"] == "工业", "工业锅炉燃烧方式"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())
cap = pd.to_numeric(coal.loc[coal["_dt"] == "电站", "对应机组装机容量（万千瓦）"], errors="coerce")
print("\ncoal 电站 capacity missing:", cap.isna().sum(), "/", len(cap))

# gas devices unit check
gas = pw[pw["燃料一类型"].isin(["天然气", "焦炉煤气", "高炉煤气", "发生炉煤气"])]
print("\ngas devices units:", gas.groupby(["燃料一类型", "燃料一消耗量单位"]).size().to_string())

# oil devices
oil = pw[pw["燃料一类型"].isin(["柴油", "燃料油", "液化天然气", "液化石油气"])]
print("\noil/LNG devices units:")
print(oil.groupby(["燃料一类型", "燃料一消耗量单位"]).size().to_string())

# fuel2 for POWER
pw2 = pw[pw["燃料二类型"].notna() & (pw["燃料二类型"].astype(str).str.strip() != "")]
print("\nPOWER fuel2 types:", pw2["燃料二类型"].value_counts().to_dict())

{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fixed-combustion POWER (电力热力源) emission inventory engine.

Method: T/CSES 144-2024 城市大气污染源排放清单编制技术指南
  - 电力热力源 (7.x): E = A x EF x (1-eta)  [公式(2)]
  - 燃煤 SO2 物料衡算 公式(3); PM2.5/PM10 公式(4); BC 公式(5); OC 公式(6)
  - EF: 附录D 表D.1; 物料衡算参数: 附录C 表C.1/C.2/C.3; 控制效率: 附录A 表A.1
  - 投运率 assumed 1.0 (no facility run-time data in inputs; documented assumption)
"""
import json, os, math, sys
import pandas as pd

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from factors import (TABLE_A1, A1_POLLUTANTS, TABLE_C1, TABLE_C2, TABLE_C3,
                     TABLE_D1, FUEL_MAP, GAS_FUELS, TECH_MAP, nox_by_capacity)

ROOT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..")
BASE = os.path.join(ROOT, "inputs")
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "outputs")
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

POWER_IND = {"4411": "火力发电", "4412": "热电联产", "4417": "生物质能发电", "4430": "热力生产和供应"}
POLLUTANTS = ["SO2", "NOx", "CO", "VOC", "PM2.5", "PM10", "BC", "OC", "NH3"]

# ---------------- load inputs ----------------
b102 = pd.read_pickle(os.path.join(OUT, "_b102.pkl"))
b10102 = pd.read_pickle(os.path.join(OUT, "_b10102.pkl"))
idx = json.load(open(os.path.join(BASE, "source_identity_index.json")))
recs = idx["records"]

def classify(icode):
    if icode in POWER_IND:
        return "POWER"
    if icode[:2] in [f"{i:02d}" for i in range(6, 13)] or (13 <= int(icode[:2]) <= 43) or icode[:2] == "45":
        return "INDUSTRIAL_BOILER"
    return "OUT_OF_SCOPE"

def to_num(v):
    if v is None or (isinstance(v, float) and math.isnan(v)):
        return None
    s = str(v).strip()
    if s == "" or s.lower() == "nan":
        return None
    try:
        return float(s)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def to_str(v):
    if v is None:
        return ""
    s = str(v).strip()
    return "" if s.lower() == "nan" else s

def components_of(row):
    """Return list of dicts: dict(fid, fuel_name, fuel_std, amount, unit, is_gas, tech, params...)."""
    comps = []
    for tag, tcol, acol, ucol in (("F1", "燃料一类型", "燃料一消耗量", "燃料一消耗量单位"),
                                  ("F2", "燃料二类型", "燃料二消耗量", "燃料二消耗量单位")):
        fuel = to_str(row[tcol])
        amt = to_num(row[acol])
        unit = to_str(row[ucol])
        if not fuel or amt is None or amt <= 0 or not unit:
            continue
        fuel_std = FUEL_MAP.get(fuel, fuel)
        comps.append(dict(fid=tag, fuel_name=fuel, fuel_std=fuel_std, amount=amt, unit=unit,
                          is_gas=(fuel_std in GAS_FUELS)))
    return comps


def fuel_params(row, tag):
    """Fuel characteristics (S, ash, capacity) for material balance."""
    p = {}
    if tag == "F1":
        p["S"] = to_num(row["燃料一平均收到基含硫量"])
        p["S_unit"] = to_str(row["燃料一平均收到基含硫量单位"])
        p["ash"] = to_num(row["燃料一平均收到基灰分（%）"])
        p["cap"] = to_num(row["对应机组装机容量（万千瓦）"])
    else:
        p["S"] = to_num(row["燃料二平均收到基含硫量"])
        p["S_unit"] = to_str(row["燃料二平均收到基含硫量单位"])
        p["ash"] = to_num(row["燃料二平均收到基灰分（%）"])
        p["cap"] = to_num(row["对应机组装机容量（万千瓦）"])
    return p


def resolve_ef(row, comp, pollutant, sector):
    """Return (ef_value_or_None, basis) for this component+pollutant."""
    fuel_std = comp["fuel_std"]
    if fuel_std is None:
        return None, f"NO_EF_FUEL_{comp['fuel_name']}"
    key = (sector, fuel_std)
    if fuel_std == "煤炭":
        tech = combustion_tech(row, comp.get("devtype", ""))
        tech_std = TECH_MAP.get(tech)
        if tech_std is None:
            return None, f"COMBUSTION_TECH_UNKNOWN_{tech}"
        d1 = TABLE_D1[(sector, "煤炭", tech_std)]
        if pollutant in ("SO2", "PM2.5", "PM10", "BC", "OC"):
            fp = fuel_params(row, comp["fid"])
            if pollutant == "SO2":
                if fp["S"] is None or (fp["S_unit"] and fp["S_unit"] != "%"):
                    return None, "COAL_SULFUR_MISSING"
                sr, _ = TABLE_C1[(sector, tech_std)]
                return 2 * fp["S"] * (1 - sr), "D1_MB_C1_SO2"
            # PM/BC/OC
            if fp["ash"] is None:
                return None, "COAL_ASH_MISSING"
            _, ar = TABLE_C1[(sector, tech_std)]
            fpm25, fpm10 = TABLE_C2[(sector, tech_std)]
            fbc, foc = TABLE_C3[(sector, tech_std)]
            ef_pm25 = fp["ash"] * 10 * (1 - ar) * fpm25
            ef_pm10 = fp["ash"] * 10 * (1 - ar) * fpm10
            if pollutant == "PM2.5":
                return ef_pm25, "D1_MB_C1C2_PM25"
            if pollutant == "PM10":
                return ef_pm10, "D1_MB_C1C2_PM10"
            if pollutant == "BC":
                return ef_pm25 * fbc, "D1_MB_C1C2C3_BC"
            if pollutant == "OC":
                return ef_pm25 * foc, "D1_MB_C1C2C3_OC"
        # CO / NOx / VOC from D.1
        if pollutant == "NOx" and sector == "电力生产":
            fp = fuel_params(row, comp["fid"])
            if fp["cap"] is None:
                return None, "CAPACITY_MISSING"
            return nox_by_capacity(fp["cap"]), "D1_CAPACITY_NOX"
        return d1[pollutant], "D1_COAL"
    # non-coal fuels
    d1_key = None
    if comp["is_gas"]:
        d1_key = (sector, fuel_std, "燃气锅炉")
    else:
        d1_key = (sector, fuel_std, "燃油锅炉")
    if d1_key not in TABLE_D1:
        return None, f"NO_EF_FUEL_{comp['fuel_name']}"
    return TABLE_D1[d1_key][pollutant], "D1"


def activity_factor(comp):
    """E(t) = A x EF x K ; K from unit."""
    if comp["is_gas"]:
        return 0.01  # A in 万m3, EF g/m3 -> t
    return 0.001  # A in t, EF g/kg -> t

def control_efficiency(enterprise_cf, row, devtype):
    """Return dict pollutant -> (eff_pct, method_str, fine, coarse, sources)."""
    # applicable CF records
    org = row["组织机构代码"]
    recs = []
    if org in enterprise_cf:
        for _, r in enterprise_cf[org].iterrows():
            code = to_str(r["对应的排放口代码"])
            proc = to_str(r["处理工艺名称"])
            if code == "DZGL" and devtype != "电站锅炉":
                continue
            if code == "GYGL" and devtype != "工业锅炉":
                continue
            if code not in ("DZGL", "GYGL", "QT"):
                continue
            recs.append(r)
    # per-pollutant measure efficiency
    eff = {p: [] for p in POLLUTANTS}  # list of (pct, method_name, kind)
    for r in recs:
        proc = to_str(r["处理工艺名称"])
        reported = to_num(r["去除效率（%）"])
        a1name = PROCESS_MAP.get(proc)
        primary = FACILITY_PRIMARY.get(to_str(r["废气治理设施名称"]))
        if a1name:
            row_a1 = TABLE_A1[a1name]
            for j, p in enumerate(A1_POLLUTANTS):
                if row_a1[j] and row_a1[j] > 0:
                    pmap = {"PM25": "PM2.5", "PM25_10": "PM10"}
                    pol = pmap.get(p, p)
                    if pol in eff:
                        eff[pol].append((row_a1[j], a1name, "A1"))
        if reported is not None:
            if primary == "SO2":
                eff["SO2"].append((reported, proc, "REPORTED"))
            elif primary == "NOx":
                eff["NOx"].append((reported, proc, "REPORTED"))
            elif primary == "PM":
                for pol in ("PM2.5", "PM10", "BC", "OC"):
                    eff[pol].append((reported, proc, "REPORTED"))
    # low-NOx flag
    if low_nox_flag(row, devtype):
        eff["NOx"].append((22, "低氮燃烧技术", "A1"))
    result = {}
    for p in POLLUTANTS:
        if p == "NH3":
            result[p] = dict(eff=0.0, method="", fine=0.0, coarse=0.0)
            continue
        if p == "VOC":
            # 标准8.2.1.2-5) 燃烧烟气源项不涉及VOCs末端治理措施，eta=0
            result[p] = dict(eff=0.0, method="", fine=0.0, coarse=0.0)
            continue
        measures = eff.get(p, [])
        if measures:
            best = max(measures, key=lambda m: m[0])
            eff_pct = best[0]
            methods = sorted({m[1] for m in measures})
            method = ";".join(methods)
        else:
            eff_pct = 0.0
            method = "无"
        fine = eff_pct if p in ("PM2.5", "PM10", "BC", "OC") else 0.0
        coarse = eff_pct if p in ("PM10",) else (fine if p in ("PM2.5", "BC", "OC") else 0.0)
        result[p] = dict(eff=eff_pct, method=method, fine=fine, coarse=coarse)
    return result


# ---------------- per-source calculation ----------------
def calc_source(row, control):
    """Return dict with per-pollutant results and component info."""
    devtype = devtype_of(row)
    comps = components_of(row)
    for c in comps:
        c["devtype"] = devtype
    sector = sector_of(row)
    out = dict(comps=comps, sector=sector, pollutants={})
    for pol in POLLUTANTS:
        gen_total = 0.0
        emis_total = 0.0
        ok = True
        reasons = []
        for c in comps:
            ef, basis = resolve_ef(row, c, pol, sector)
            if ef is None:
                ok = False
                reasons.append(f"{c['fid']}:{basis}")
                continue
            k = activity_factor(c)
            g = c["amount"] * ef * k
            eta = control[pol]["eff"] / 100.0
            e = g * (1 - eta)
            gen_total += g
            emis_total += e
        if pol == "NH3":
            out["pollutants"][pol] = dict(status="information_insufficient",
                                          reason="NH3_EF_UNAVAILABLE", gen=None, emis=None)
        elif ok:
            out["pollutants"][pol] = dict(status="calculated", reason=";".join(sorted(set(reasons))) if reasons else "OK",
                                          gen=gen_total, emis=emis_total)
        else:
            out["pollutants"][pol] = dict(status="information_insufficient",
                                          reason=";".join(sorted(set(reasons))), gen=None, emis=None)
    return out


def main():
    # enterprise -> CF records
    enterprise_cf = {org: g for org, g in b10102.groupby("组织机构代码")}

    decisions = []
    inventory = []
    exceptions = {}

    for _, row in b102.iterrows():
        sid = row["source_id"]
        cls = row["_cls"]
        ind = row["_ind"]
        devtype = devtype_of(row)
        if cls == "POWER":
            control = control_efficiency(enterprise_cf, row, devtype)
            res = calc_source(row, control)
            decisions.append(dict(source_id=sid, requested_target="POWER", decided_target="POWER",
                                  disposition="included",
                                  reason_code=f"SCOPE_POWER_{ind}"))
            # build per-pollutant rows
            comps = res["comps"]
            # activity/parameter/control arrays per component
            for pol in POLLUTANTS:
                act = []
                par = []
                ctl = []
                for c in comps:
                    act.append(dict(component_id=c["fid"], value=c["amount"], unit=c["unit"]))
                    # parameter records
                    pars = []
                    ef, basis = resolve_ef(row, c, pol, sector_of(row))
                    if ef is not None:
                        pars.append(dict(component_id=c["fid"], parameter_id=f"EF_{pol}",
                                         mode="standard" if basis.startswith("D1") else basis,
                                         value=ef, unit="g/m3" if c["is_gas"] else "g/kg"))
                    else:
                        pars.append(dict(component_id=c["fid"], parameter_id="EF_UNAVAILABLE",
                                         mode="not_available", value=None, unit=None))
                    # for coal material balance, add S/ash parameters
                    if c["fuel_std"] == "煤炭":
                        fp = fuel_params(row, c["fid"])
                        pars.append(dict(component_id=c["fid"], parameter_id="SULFUR",
                                         mode="source", value=fp["S"], unit="%"))
                        pars.append(dict(component_id=c["fid"], parameter_id="ASH",
                                         mode="source", value=fp["ash"], unit="%"))
                    par.append(pars)
                    # control records
                    ctl.append(dict(component_id=c["fid"],
                                    method=control[pol]["method"] if control[pol]["method"] else "无",
                                    efficiency=control[pol]["eff"],
                                    fine_efficiency=control[pol]["fine"],
                                    coarse_efficiency=control[pol]["coarse"]))
                # flatten parameter arrays element-wise: one JSON object per component
                par_flat = [par[i] for i in range(len(comps))]
                pr = res["pollutants"][pol]
                inventory.append(dict(
                    source_id=sid, target="POWER", pollutant=pol, status=pr["status"],
                    method="产排污系数法(公式2)" if pr["status"] == "calculated" else "—",
                    activity_record_json=json.dumps(act, ensure_ascii=False),
                    parameter_record_json=json.dumps(par_flat, ensure_ascii=False),
                    control_record_json=json.dumps(ctl, ensure_ascii=False),
                    generation_t="" if pr["gen"] is None else round(pr["gen"], 6),
                    emission_t="" if pr["emis"] is None else round(pr["emis"], 6),
                    standard_reference="T/CSES 144-2024",
                    reason_code=pr["reason"]))
                # exceptions
                if pr["status"] != "calculated":
                    rc = pr["reason"]
                    for part in rc.split(";"):
                        if part.startswith("F1:") or part.startswith("F2:"):
                            key = ("EF_UNAVAILABLE", part.split(":")[1])
                        else:
                            key = (part, "")
                        if key not in exceptions:
                            exceptions[key] = dict(pollutants=set(), sources=[])
                        exceptions[key]["pollutants"].add(pol)
                        exceptions[key]["sources"].append(sid)
        else:
            reason = f"INDUSTRY_{ind}_NOT_POWER_SCOPE" if cls == "INDUSTRIAL_BOILER" else f"OUT_OF_SCOPE_{ind}"
            decisions.append(dict(source_id=sid, requested_target="POWER", decided_target=cls,
                                  disposition="not_involved", reason_code=reason))

    # ---- write outputs ----
    df_dec = pd.DataFrame(decisions, columns=["source_id", "requested_target", "decided_target", "disposition", "reason_code"])
    df_dec.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "source_decisions.csv"), index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

    df_inv = pd.DataFrame(inventory, columns=["source_id", "target", "pollutant", "status", "method",
                                              "activity_record_json", "parameter_record_json",
                                              "control_record_json", "generation_t", "emission_t",
                                              "standard_reference", "reason_code"])
    df_inv.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "generic_inventory_items.csv"), index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

    df_disp = df_dec[["source_id", "requested_target", "disposition", "reason_code"]].rename(
        columns={"requested_target": "target"})
    df_disp.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "generic_source_disposition.csv"), index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

    # exceptions: one row per root-cause group
    exc_rows = []
    for i, (key, v) in enumerate(exceptions.items(), 1):
        root_cause, extra = key
        pols = ",".join(sorted(v["pollutants"]))
        srcs = v["sources"]
        exc_rows.append(dict(exception_id=f"EXC-{i:03d}", source_id=srcs[0], pollutant=pols,
                             root_cause=root_cause, action_required="由用户补充T/CSES 144-2024以外的产生系数/数据"))
    df_exc = pd.DataFrame(exc_rows, columns=["exception_id", "source_id", "pollutant", "root_cause", "action_required"])
    df_exc.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "generic_exception_list.csv"), index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

    # summary
    n_src = df_dec["source_id"].nunique()
    n_items = len(df_inv)
    status_counts = df_inv["status"].value_counts().to_dict()
    summary = dict(

{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""QA the output files: schema, uniqueness, alignment of JSON arrays, non-negativity, coverage."""
import json, os, sys
import pandas as pd

OUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "outputs")

print("========== source_decisions.csv ==========")
d = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "source_decisions.csv"))
print("cols:", list(d.columns), "| rows:", len(d))
assert list(d.columns) == ["source_id", "requested_target", "decided_target", "disposition", "reason_code"]
assert d["source_id"].is_unique, "source_id not unique"
assert (d["requested_target"] == "POWER").all()
assert d["decided_target"].isin(["POWER", "INDUSTRIAL_BOILER", "OUT_OF_SCOPE"]).all()
assert d["disposition"].isin(["included", "not_involved"]).all()
print("decided:", d["decided_target"].value_counts().to_dict())

print("\n========== generic_source_disposition.csv ==========")
g = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "generic_source_disposition.csv"))
print("cols:", list(g.columns), "| rows:", len(g))
assert list(g.columns) == ["source_id", "target", "disposition", "reason_code"]
assert g["source_id"].is_unique
assert (g["target"] == "POWER").all()
print("disposition:", g["disposition"].value_counts().to_dict())
# cross check with decisions
merged = d.merge(g, on="source_id", suffixes=("_d", "_g"))
assert (merged["disposition_d"] == merged["disposition_g"]).all()
assert (merged["reason_code_d"] == merged["reason_code_g"]).all()
print("decision/disposition cross-check OK")

print("\n========== generic_inventory_items.csv ==========")
inv = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "generic_inventory_items.csv"))
print("cols:", list(inv.columns), "| rows:", len(inv))
expected_cols = ["source_id", "target", "pollutant", "status", "method",
                 "activity_record_json", "parameter_record_json", "control_record_json",
                 "generation_t", "emission_t", "standard_reference", "reason_code"]
assert list(inv.columns) == expected_cols, list(inv.columns)
assert (inv["target"] == "POWER").all()
assert inv["status"].isin(["calculated", "not_involved", "information_insufficient", "source_data_invalid"]).all()
print("status:", inv["status"].value_counts().to_dict())
print("pollutants:", sorted(inv["pollutant"].unique()))
# per source: exactly 9 pollutant rows
pc = inv.groupby("source_id")["pollutant"].count()
assert (pc == 9).all(), pc[pc != 9]
print("each source has 9 pollutant rows: OK")

# JSON array checks
errs = 0
for i, r in inv.iterrows():
    try:
        act = json.loads(r["activity_record_json"])
        par = json.loads(r["parameter_record_json"])
        ctl = json.loads(r["control_record_json"])
    except Exception as e:
        print("JSON parse error row", i, e)
        errs += 1
        continue
    if not (isinstance(act, list) and isinstance(par, list) and isinstance(ctl, list)):
        print("not list row", i); errs += 1; continue
    if not (len(act) == len(par) == len(ctl)):
        print("length mismatch row", i, len(act), len(par), len(ctl)); errs += 1; continue
    if not act:
        print("empty arrays row", i); errs += 1; continue
    for j in range(len(act)):
        if act[j].get("component_id") != par[j].get("component_id") or act[j].get("component_id") != ctl[j].get("component_id"):
            print("component_id mismatch row", i, "idx", j); errs += 1; break
        for f in ["component_id", "value", "unit"]:
            if f not in act[j]:
                print("act missing field", f, "row", i); errs += 1
        for f in ["component_id", "parameter_id", "mode", "value", "unit"]:
            if f not in par[j]:
                print("par missing field", f, "row", i); errs += 1
        for f in ["component_id", "method", "efficiency", "fine_efficiency", "coarse_efficiency"]:
            if f not in ctl[j]:
                print("ctl missing field", f, "row", i); errs += 1
        # non-negative
        for f in ["value"]:
            v = act[j][f]
            if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and v < 0:
                print("negative act value row", i); errs += 1
        for f in ["efficiency", "fine_efficiency", "coarse_efficiency"]:
            v = ctl[j][f]
            if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and v < 0:
                print("negative ctl value row", i, f); errs += 1
        pv = par[j]["value"]
        if isinstance(pv, (int, float)) and pv < 0:
            print("negative par value row", i); errs += 1
print("JSON array errors:", errs)

# generation/emission non-negative + status consistency
for col in ["generation_t", "emission_t"]:
    num = pd.to_numeric(inv[col], errors="coerce")
    neg = (num < 0).sum()
    print(f"{col}: non-empty={num.notna().sum()} negative={neg}")
    assert neg == 0
calc = inv[inv["status"] == "calculated"]
assert (pd.to_numeric(calc["generation_t"], errors="coerce").notna()).all()
assert (pd.to_numeric(calc["emission_t"], errors="coerce").notna()).all()
insuff = inv[inv["status"] != "calculated"]
assert insuff["generation_t"].isna().all() or (insuff["generation_t"].astype(str).str.strip() == "").all(), \
    "insufficient rows should have empty generation"
print("status <-> value consistency OK")

# emission <= generation
assert (pd.to_numeric(calc["emission_t"]) <= pd.to_numeric(calc["generation_t"]) * 1.0000001).all()
print("emission <= generation OK")

print("\n========== generic_exception_list.csv ==========")
e = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "generic_exception_list.csv"))
print("cols:", list(e.columns), "| rows:", len(e))
print(e.to_string())

print("\n========== generic_run_summary.json ==========")
s = json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT, "generic_run_summary.json")))
print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in s.items() if k != "output_paths"}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)[:1800])

"""Manual spot-check of selected inventory rows."""
import json, os, sys

    for _, r in rows.iterrows():
        if pols and r["pollutant"] not in pols:
            continue

        print(f"        par={json.dumps(par, ensure_ascii=False)}")
        print(f"        ctl={json.dumps(ctl, ensure_ascii=False)}")

"""Final spot-checks + B101 cross-validation + coverage checks."""
import json, os, pandas as pd

inv = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "generic_inventory_items.csv"))
dec = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "source_decisions.csv"))
b102 = pd.read_pickle(os.path.join(OUT, "_b102.pkl"))
b101 = pd.read_pickle(os.path.join(OUT, "_b101.pkl"))

def show_rows(sid, pols):
    rows = inv[(inv["source_id"] == sid) & (inv["pollutant"].isin(pols))]
    for _, r in rows.iterrows():
        gen = r["generation_t"]
        emis = r["emission_t"]
        print(f"    {r['pollutant']:>5} {r['status']:<24} gen={gen!s:<12} emis={emis!s:<12} eta_ctl={json.loads(r['control_record_json'])[0]['efficiency']}")

print("=== 4430 coal industrial boiler (row 88: 一般烟煤 30000t, 链条炉, S=0.35, ash=7.23) ===")
# find source id for excel row 88
row88 = b102.index[b102.index == 86][0]  # pandas index 86 = excel row 88
sid = b102.loc[86, "source_id"]
print("source:", sid)
show_rows(sid, ["SO2", "NOx", "CO", "VOC", "PM2.5", "PM10"])

print("\n=== 4417 coke oven gas turbine (row 1283: 焦炉煤气 38.885万m3) ===")
sid = b102.loc[1281, "source_id"]
print("source:", sid)
show_rows(sid, ["SO2", "NOx", "CO", "VOC", "PM2.5", "BC"])

print("\n=== 4430 gas power boiler (row 240: 天然气 791万m3, 室燃炉) ===")
sid = b102.loc[238, "source_id"]
print("source:", sid)
show_rows(sid, ["SO2", "NOx", "VOC", "PM2.5"])

print("\n=== 4411 coal CFB (row 1190: 原煤 163925.23t, 循环流化床锅炉, cap 13.5万千瓦, S=0.61, ash=16.39) ===")
sid = b102.loc[1188, "source_id"]
print("source:", sid)
show_rows(sid, ["SO2", "NOx", "PM2.5"])

print("\n=== 4412 coal 煤粉炉 cap 5万千瓦 (row 1029: 一般烟煤 67038t, S=0.81) ===")
sid = b102.loc[1027, "source_id"]
print("source:", sid)
show_rows(sid, ["NOx", "SO2"])

# ---- B101 cross-check: enterprise industry codes consistent
b101k = b101[["组织机构代码", "行业类别代码"]].drop_duplicates()
b102k = b102[["组织机构代码", "行业类别代码"]].drop_duplicates()
m = b102k.merge(b101k, on="组织机构代码", suffixes=("_b102", "_b101"))
mismatch = m[m["行业类别代码_b102"].astype(str) != m["行业类别代码_b101"].astype(str)]
print("\n=== B101 vs B102 industry code mismatches (enterprise level):", len(mismatch), "===")
print(mismatch.head(10).to_string() if len(mismatch) else "(none)")

# ---- coverage: inventory sources == included decisions == POWER 145
inv_sources = set(inv["source_id"])
inc_sources = set(dec.loc[dec["disposition"] == "included", "source_id"])
print("\ninv sources:", len(inv_sources), "| included decisions:", len(inc_sources), "| equal:", inv_sources == inc_sources)

# ---- totals by pollutant (calculated only)
calc = inv[inv["status"] == "calculated"]
tot = calc.groupby("pollutant")[["generation_t", "emission_t"]].apply(lambda g: g.astype(float).sum())
print("\n=== calculated totals (t) by pollutant ===")
print(tot.round(3).to_string())

# per-industry status counts
b102["source_id"] = (b102.index + 2).map({r["source_row"]: r["source_id"] for r in json.load(open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "inputs", "source_identity_index.json")))["records"]})
inv2 = inv.merge(b102[["source_id", "行业类别代码"]], on="source_id")
print("\n=== status x industry (POWER) ===")
print(inv2.groupby(["行业类别代码", "status"]).size().to_string())

{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Final verification: source-level status, remaining edge devices, sample output eyeball."""
import json, os, pandas as pd

OUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "outputs")
inv = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "generic_inventory_items.csv"))

# source-level status: a source is 'calculated' if all 9 rows calculated
src_status = inv.groupby("source_id")["status"].agg(lambda s: "calculated" if (s == "calculated").all() else "insufficient")
print("source-level status:", src_status.value_counts().to_dict())

# find sources with mixed status (should be none: insufficient sources have all 9 insufficient? NH3 always insufficient)
mixed = inv.groupby("source_id")["status"].nunique()
print("sources with mixed statuses:", (mixed > 1).sum())
if (mixed > 1).any():
    for sid in mixed[mixed > 1].index:
        print("  ", sid, inv[inv["source_id"] == sid]["status"].value_counts().to_dict())

# check the 4417 gas/coke devices
b102 = pd.read_pickle(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "_work", "_b102.pkl"))
idx_recs = json.load(open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "inputs", "source_identity_index.json")))["records"]
b102["source_id"] = (b102.index + 2).map({r["source_row"]: r["source_id"] for r in idx_recs})
b102["_ind"] = b102["行业类别代码"].astype(str)
pw = b102[b102["_ind"].isin(["4411", "4412", "4417", "4430"])]
gas = pw[pw["燃料一类型"].isin(["天然气", "焦炉煤气"])]
print("\n=== 4417 gas/coke devices ===")
for _, r in gas.iterrows():
    f2 = r["燃料二类型"] if pd.notna(r["燃料二类型"]) else "-"
    st = src_status.get(r["source_id"], "?")
    print(f"  {r['source_id']} {r['行业类别代码']} dev={str(r['电站锅炉/燃气轮机类型'])[:10]:<10} fuel1={r['燃料一类型']} {r['燃料一消耗量']}{r['燃料一消耗量单位']} fuel2={f2} status={st}")

# 煤制品 device
cp = pw[pw["燃料一类型"] == "煤制品"]
print("\n=== 煤制品 device ===")
for _, r in cp.iterrows():
    print(f"  {r['source_id']} {r['行业类别代码']} fuel2={r['燃料二类型']} {r['燃料二消耗量']}{r['燃料二消耗量单位']} status={src_status.get(r['source_id'],'?')}")

# sample rows of each output
print("\n=== source_decisions.csv sample ===")
d = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "source_decisions.csv"))
print(d.head(3).to_string())
print(d[d["decided_target"] == "OUT_OF_SCOPE"].head(3).to_string())
print(d[d["decided_target"] == "INDUSTRIAL_BOILER"].head(2).to_string())

print("\n=== generic_inventory_items.csv sample (calculated SO2 row) ===")
print(inv[(inv["pollutant"] == "SO2") & (inv["status"] == "calculated")].head(2).to_string(max_colwidth=60))

print("\n=== generic_run_summary.json ===")
s = json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT, "generic_run_summary.json")))
print(json.dumps(s, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
